_about: Par (standard) times at Epsom, DRAFT, for the race engine and the race view's dock. 'winningTime' is a rough winning time for a good horse on good ground (from memory: check against real results); 'seconds' is the par the engine uses, set by tools/course/epsom/calibrate.mjs so its winning times come out at those.

pace._about: How the dock judges the pace. Each section the leader runs is compared with par for its length at the race's average par speed; the first section (from a standing start) gets firstSectionExtra seconds of allowance. Ratio = actual time / par time.
